explanation: Evidence provided only supports avoiding CYP3A inhibitors and grapefruit; no evidence source states avoiding strong CYP3A inducers like rifampin, yet the slide asserts this as a recommendation.
suggested_rewrite: Avoid concomitant strong CYP3A inhibitors (e.g., clarithromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole) and grapefruit or grapefruit juice during treatment; remove the unsupported inducer/rifampin guidance unless separate evidence is cited.
